# Trust Center

#### Trust. Compliance. Performance

Bizagi is built for enterprise security, standards and scalability, ensuring that your process applications meet your needs and the stringent requirements of global regulators. That’s why Bizagi is used by banks, government agencies and in every other industry across the globe.

![Padlock icon overlayed on motherboard](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/padlock-on-motherboard.png)

![Close up of code on screen](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/code-on-screen.png?t=thumbnail3)

##### Security

Bizagi cloud’s security features comply with the latest industry standards for data security and privacy.

[View more](https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/security)

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/web-of-lights.png?t=thumbnail3)

##### Compliance

Bizagi cloud makes it easy to maintain compliance with increasingly demanding local and global regulations.

[View more](https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/compliance)

![Aerial view of Europe on globe](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/europe-on-globe.png?t=thumbnail3)

##### Availability

Bizagi cloud enables users to access applications whenever they need to from wherever they are, even during maintenance and service upgrades.

[View more](https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/availability)

![](https://www.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/bizagi/files/Platform/pexels-miguel-%c3%a1-padri%c3%b1%c3%a1n-2882638.jpg?t=thumbnail3)
